forwardBaseline.historicalSameWeekRate: median of the same ISO week across available prior seasons (2024, 2025)
forwardBaseline.levelFactor: last 4 weeks this year / same 4 weeks prior year
forwardBaseline.netOf: estimatedCasesOnHand from current_stock.json, correctable by a rep count

guardrails.shelfLifeGuard: never recommend more than sellable before expiry or the season taper
guardrails.creditAssumption: The rep may book beyond the credit limit. Credit is advisory, not a hard block.
guardrails.coolerMode: cap chilled packs to available cooler slots
guardrails.peerDisclosure: Aggregated and anonymised only. Never a named outlet.

deLoadTriggers: monsoon onset forecast inside the window
overstock history with high days of cover

seasonWindowLabel: Peak week. Pune's hottest spell ran 20 Apr to 6 May.
dataProvenance: Synthetic. 240 outlets and 60 SKUs are our assumptions, not figures supplied by the brief. Persona settings follow docs/personas_v2.md Appendix A.
